request: Analyze GSE230002 for PMID 37365374 (Dietary weight loss-induced improvements in metabolic function are enhanced by exercise in people with obesity and prediabetes.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk total-RNA RNA-seq of vastus lateralis muscle (S3.10.2.p1, S1.4.p1)
final.design: two parallel arms (concurrent trials NCT02706288 / NCT02706262), each sampled Before and After ~10% weight loss; Diet+EX (calorie restriction + multi-modal exercise) vs Diet-ONLY (calorie restriction alone) (S3.1.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: RNA-seq on Diet-ONLY n=6 and Diet+EX n=7 (one Diet+EX sample excluded for poor RNA quality) (FIG8, S3.10.2.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Within-arm change in muscle gene expression After vs Before weight loss, in Diet+EX (the exercise-containing arm) and in Diet-ONLY; the exercise contribution is read as the difference between the two arms' responses (S1.4.p1, S3.13.2.1.p1). The paper tested the between-arm difference only for selected genes by ANCOVA (FIG8).
planned_contrasts: Diet+EX After vs Before (S1.4.p1; paper: 877 DEGs, 623 up / 254 down)
Diet-ONLY After vs Before (S1.4.p1; paper: 1 DEG, HMOX1 down)
final.paper_method: edgeR 3.40.2, Before vs After within each group (S3.13.2.1.p1); expression presented as log2 CPM (S3.10.2.p1)
final.paper_results: 877 DEGs in Diet+EX (623 up, 254 down), 1 DEG in Diet-ONLY (HMOX1 down); upregulated DEGs enriched for mitochondrial energy metabolism and angiogenesis GO-BP terms (DAVID, FDR<0.01); key genes PPARGC1A, MFF, CS, MDH1, CYCS, ATP5F1A, ACADVL, ACADM, LPL, CD36, VEGFA, KDR increased more in Diet+EX (S1.4.p1, FIG8)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Study map from S3.1.p1 (arms, trials), S3.10.2.p1 (RNA-seq, exclusion), S3.13.2.1.p1 (edgeR, threshold), S1.4.p1 and FIG8 (counts, genes). The exercise question is answered by the Diet+EX within-arm change against the Diet-ONLY within-arm change.

checks: DA.p1 names GSE230002 as this study's RNA-seq deposit
GEO: Homo sapiens skeletal muscle, before/after 10% weight loss in people with obesity and prediabetes, Washington University group
26 samples = 13 participants x 2 timepoints, matching Diet-ONLY n=6 + Diet+EX n=7 (FIG8)

ownership.reasoning: Accession named in the paper's data availability; sample structure matches the paper's RNA-seq n.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns equal metadata title exactly (inspect: 26/26). GEO carries only a Before/After treatment field; the arm is not labelled. Title prefixes split participants into PE (7) and PSQ (6). The paper's RNA-seq arms are Diet+EX n=7 and Diet-ONLY n=6 (FIG8), so PE = Diet+EX (EX) and PSQ = Diet-ONLY (DIET); this is the only count-consistent assignment. Supporting check on the deposited values: PPARGC1A rises in all 7 PE participants (paper: increased with Diet+EX) and HMOX1 falls in 5/6 PSQ participants (paper's single Diet-ONLY DEG). Time from the Pre/Post suffix agrees with the GEO treatment field (Before/After); subject is the participant ID.
